# Port Jersey Logistics Network

Port Jersey Logistics Network is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Port Jersey Logistics Network delivers end-to-end supply chain solutions across warehousing, transportation, and distribution. Reliable service, nationwide reach, and decades of logistics expertise. Port Jersey Logistics Network employs 94 people (+30.6% YoY, +22 people) and has an annual revenue of $8M, founded in 1954. Headquartered in Cranbury, New Jersey, United States.

## About

Centered in the heart of the nation's largest market, Port Jersey offers it all to domestic manufacturers and international shippers alike—from public warehousing and distribution to supply chain management. We combine more than half a century of 3PL experience with the latest state-of-the-art systems and facilities to meet even the most demanding international and local logistics requirements. 

Our strategically situated warehouse locations allow effective, efficient product distribution throughout the Northeast, the East Coast corridor and the entire country. And we’re committed to damage-free delivery to the right location, at the right time, every time

results.text:
# Continental Logistics

Continental Logistics is a Truck Transportation company. Port Jersey Logistics Network delivers end-to-end supply chain solutions across warehousing, transportation, and distribution. Reliable service, nationwide reach, and decades of logistics expertise. Continental Logistics employs 59 people (+1.7% YoY, +1 person) and has an annual revenue of $22M, founded in 1983. Headquartered in Map Ta Phut, Rayong, United States, with presence in India. Its workforce is distributed across 5 countries (including United States, Democratic Republic of the Congo, France, India, and Zimbabwe).

## About

As an expanded service offering within Port Jersey Logistics, Continental Logistics was founded in 1983 to serve as a compliment to Port Jersey Transportation. Port Jersey Transportation, founded originally in 1954, was a long standing respected northeast regional carrier primarily serving the grocery industry from New England through Baltimore, MD.

However, with customer needs expanding beyond the markets being serviced directly, Continental Logistics began managing the transportation needs of customers beyond the scope of Port Jersey Transportation.

As time has passed Continental Logistics now stands alone having its rich heritage in transportation within Port Jersey Logistics. We offer a full suite of transportation services and logistics management for food products to clients throughout North America and other varied parts of the globe.

properties.name: Continental Logistics
properties.description:
As an expanded service offering within Port Jersey Logistics, Continental Logistics was founded in 1983 to serve as a compliment to Port Jersey Transportation. Port Jersey Transportation, founded originally in 1954, was a long standing respected northeast regional carrier primarily serving the grocery industry from New England through Baltimore, MD.

However, with customer needs expanding beyond the markets being serviced directly, Continental Logistics began managing the transportation needs of customers beyond the scope of Port Jersey Transportation.

As time has passed Continental Logistics now stands alone having its rich heritage in transportation within Port Jersey Logistics. We offer a full suite of transportation services and logistics management for food products to clients throughout North America and other varied parts of the globe.
